cloud.title: Add cloud account
cloud.description:
Enter your Fully Cloud REST API credentials. Once the cloud account is added, all Fully Cloud devices available to the API token are added to Home Assistant.

{error_detail}

local.title: Add local device
local.description:
Add one Fully Kiosk device reachable from Home Assistant. Fully Kiosk Remote Admin commonly uses port 2323.

{error_detail}

local_bulk.title: Add multiple local devices
local_bulk.description:
Add one local Fully Kiosk device per line. Use ip|password, ip:port|password, devid|ip|password, or a full URL.

{error_detail}

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Fully Cloud.
error.invalid_auth: Fully Cloud rejected the email or API token.
error.invalid_local_devices: One or more local device entries are invalid.
error.local_cannot_connect: Could not connect to one or more local Fully Kiosk devices.
error.local_bulk_partial_failure: Some local Fully Kiosk devices could not be reached.

abort.already_configured: This Fully Cloud account or local device is already configured.

init.title: Fully Cloud EMM options
init.description:
Optional local Fully Kiosk Remote Admin endpoints. Use one device per line: http://192.168.1.50:2323|password or devid|http://192.168.1.50:2323|password. If the port is omitted, 2323 is used.

{error_detail}

error.invalid_local_devices: One or more local device entries are invalid.
error.local_cannot_connect: Could not connect to one or more local Fully Kiosk devices.
